description: This file contains a React functional component called FormWizard which implements a multi-step form wizard with validation, progress indicators, and review/edit functionalities. It manages form state, step navigation, validation logic, and rendering of various form sections including account details, profile info, preferences, and review sections.

methods.name: validateStep
methods.description: Validates the form data for a specific step; checks required fields and email format.

methods.name: step1Valid
methods.description: Memoized boolean indicating whether Step 1 data passes validation criteria.

methods.name: step2Valid
methods.description: Memoized boolean indicating whether Step 2 data passes validation criteria.

methods.name: step3Valid
methods.description: Memoized boolean indicating whether Step 3 data passes validation criteria.

methods.name: canProceed()
methods.description: Determines if the user can proceed to the next step based on current step's validity.

methods.name: goToStep
methods.description: Navigates to a specific step, validating previous steps if necessary.

methods.name: next
methods.description: Advances to the next step if the current step is valid.

methods.name: onChange
methods.description: Handles updating form data state upon input changes.

methods.name: startEdit
methods.description: Enters edit mode for a specific review section and navigates to that step.

methods.name: saveFromEdit
methods.description: Validates and saves edits made in review mode, then returns to review.
